body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-1010 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-1010), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-1010, beta = 1 - 6e-1010, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-1013 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-1010. Endpoint recertification: native and conservative complex endpoints refined to 1e-1000 (accept at endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-1000) with the repaired fine engines evaluated in directed-rounding integer fixed point; kappa exceeds PR1876 by 8.11857e-401, PR1875 by 6.06686e-301 and PR1839 by 6.56133e-91 (62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls).

Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0. (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-2e-100, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md).
